description:
[writes · `ads:manage` scope] Sends ONE server-side CompleteRegistration to a Meta pixel on the brand's selected ad account with Meta's test code (testEventCode, from Events Manager → the dataset → Test events; required), to prove the Conversions API path delivers. Optional pixelId (default: the pixel saved for the ad account, or its only active one). It creates nothing and spends nothing, and never sends without a test code. outcome "delivered" only when Meta counted the event; "rejected" carries Meta's error codes in failureCodes. 409 ADS_PIXEL_NOT_ON_AD_ACCOUNT lists the pixels Meta has for the ad account and the step to share the missing one. The event cannot be taken back: Meta also counts it in the dataset totals. Needs agentName and reason, and the ads:manage scope.
(Wraps POST /api/v2/ads/conversions/test-events.)

agentName.description: Which agent is acting. Shown to the owner in Ads > Agent activity.

brandId.description: A brand id (GET /api/v2/brands) or "personal"; default: the key owner's active brand.

pixelId.description: Optional Meta pixel (dataset) id. Default: the pixel saved for the ad account, or its only active pixel.

reason.description: Why the agent is doing this. Shown to the owner and kept in the audit trail.

testEventCode.description: The code from Meta Events Manager → the dataset → Test events (e.g. TEST12345). Up to 32 letters, digits, "_" or "-".

name: ads_conversion_test_event
title: Send a test conversion event
